G25 records are event-based time series — each flood event is a separate record with a date. Multiple events at same location are separate records. Confidence rating is mandatory (High/Medium/Low) — affects weight in G24 model calibration. Historic events (pre-2026) should be included where verifiable sources exist — minimum date = 2000 recommended for baseline.
